criterion.description: Ours must have a strictly higher accuracy with non-overlapping 95% bootstrap bands while having no higher p95 TTFA or compute than B9 at matched price operating points, over a contiguous region, in at least 3 of 5 seeds.

verdict: Ours does NOT meet the preregistered dominance criterion: 0/5 seeds satisfy contiguous strict dominance (requires >= 3).
